name: Forsyth
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Forsyth, GA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Forsyth, Georgia and Monroe County for 2026: a downtown parade, Jingle N Mingle, Juliette lights and more.
lede: Forsyth starts its holidays downtown, with a tree lighting, an evening parade through town and a street party with music, vendors and a kids zone.
celebrates: Forsyth celebrates Christmas in its downtown around the Courthouse Square. The city's tourism site says the season opens with the Christmas Tree Lighting, where families join Santa and sing along, followed by Small Business Saturday, when downtown merchants run specials. In early December the Forsyth-Monroe Chamber's Hometown Holiday Parade rolls through downtown in the evening, and Forsyth Main Street hosts Jingle N Mingle with live music, vendors, food trucks and a kids zone. In nearby Juliette, Jarrell Plantation offers a Christmas Traditions Tour of its decorated historic farm houses, and Pate Road has a drive-through display of lights and music.
lastyear: In 2025 the Forsyth-Monroe Chamber's Hometown Holidays Parade stepped off at 7 pm on Thursday, December 4, in downtown Forsyth, with the theme A Holiday Movie Celebration. Two days later Jingle-N-Mingle and Candy Cane Crawl ran from 11 am to 4 pm around the Courthouse Square, with Santa Ken Kringle, Christmas vendors, food trucks, music and a kids zone. The city's lineup also included Scrooge, the Stingiest Man in Town, at the Rose Theater from December 12 to 14, and a Christmas Tour of Homes on December 13.
facts: Forsyth rings in the New Year on its historic Courthouse Square with live entertainment, a midnight countdown and a Forsythia Ball Drop, according to the city's tourism site. The Hometown Holiday Parade is the chamber's 36th annual in 2026, and its 34th was held in 2024 with a visit from Santa. A 2024 news list said the parade runs along Tift College Drive through the heart of downtown. Juliette, where Jarrell Plantation and Pate Road sit, was made famous by the movie Fried Green Tomatoes, the city's tourism site says.
trains: Forsyth does not have a Santa train of its own. Rally's Georgia Christmas train rides guide lists nine rides for 2026, and the closest to Middle Georgia is the SAM Shortline in Cordele, about an hour from Macon, with the Cordele Holiday Train and the Candy Cane Express to Plains. Check the guide for dates, prices and the booking link before you plan a drive.

faq: What Christmas traditions does Forsyth have for kids?

Forsyth's tourism site lists a downtown tree lighting with Santa, a chamber parade with floats and dance troupes, and Jingle N Mingle, which has a kids zone, live music and food trucks. Jarrell Plantation in Juliette adds a decorated historic house tour. Families can find the details for each on the City of Forsyth tourism site.
When does the Forsyth Christmas parade usually happen?

The Forsyth-Monroe Chamber holds its Hometown Holiday Parade in the first week of December. It was on Thursday, December 4, in 2025 and on December 5 in 2024, in each case at 7 pm in downtown Forsyth. Check the City of Forsyth tourism calendar for the current year's date.
Is there a Christmas lights drive near Forsyth?

The City of Forsyth's tourism calendar lists Christmas Lights on Pate Road in Juliette, a drive-through display of lights and music on Wednesday to Sunday evenings from 6 to 9 pm. Juliette is in Monroe County, a short drive from downtown Forsyth, and families can pair it with the downtown parade.
Where can families find a Christmas train near Forsyth?

The closest Santa trains listed by Rally are in Cordele, run by the SAM Shortline. The Georgia Christmas train rides guide has dates, prices and ticket links, and it says Macon is about an hour from Cordele, so Forsyth families can plan a day trip that includes a holiday train ride.

We check every date on an official calendar, and each listing links straight there.
